name: Ports
description: See what's listening on your Mac's network ports, like a dev server on 3000, and stop it.
whatsNew: Zephydian is now Zephdeck: updated for the new name.

howTo.goal: Shows which apps are listening on your Mac's network ports, like a dev server on 3000, and lets you stop them.
rules: Stop asks an app to quit; Force ends it at once.
Only your own apps can be stopped.
